q: How does a Trichy boiler parts fabricator count the steel plate and tube it buys?
title: Trichy boiler fabricator steel in Scope 3
short: As Scope 3 category 1, purchased goods: tonnes of plate and tube times a supplier-specific factor, or a route average if none is given. Your own Scope 1 covers stress relieving furnaces and cutting gases; welding power is Scope 2.
audience: Boiler, pressure part and structural fabricators around Tiruchirappalli

ol: Total tonnes of plate, tube and sections bought, from invoices.
A factor per tonne from each mill, or a published route average.
Multiply and add up by supplier.

ul: Fuel for stress relieving and heat treatment furnaces.
LPG and other gases for cutting and preheating.
Electricity for welding and machining, as Scope 2.

sections.h: When a customer asks for a product figure
p: Share the steel by the weight that goes into each job, add your process emissions per job, and allow for offcuts that are sold as scrap.

senseible: Senseible reads supplier invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so each purchased material in a Scope 3 figure traces back to its document.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
